directoryStems.mcq-7332a8989ce2a0b737f3a7c3: A 75-year-old woman receiving palliative care for advanced pancreatic cancer wishes to remain intimate with her husband. She had estrogen-receptor-positive breast cancer ten years ago and now has severe dyspareunia from vaginal atrophy. Long-acting morphine controls her other pain. Which approach best reflects Hazzard's discussion of sexuality in palliative care?
directoryStems.mcq-bdbc143475846cb1e2aff577: A 70-year-old woman with heart failure, diabetes, and arthritis reports that her medications are affecting sexual function. She takes metoprolol, furosemide, metformin, and gabapentin for neuropathic pain and asks about changing treatment. Which approach best reflects the source's discussion of medication-related sexual concerns in older women?
